hook: Fewer false wake-ups for a self-hosted voice assistant.

beats.say: Fabio Manganiello swapped openWakeWord for microWakeWord, the engine used by ESPHome and Home Assistant Voice, in his Platypush assistant.
openWakeWord's pre-trained models were version 0.1 files from 2023, mostly trained on synthetic speech, and false triggers were high with cheap mics.
Now an adaptive noise floor ignores any frame that isn't at least twice as loud as the tracked background level, roughly six decibels.
